source_excerpt: Lot coverage shall apply to R-MF, R-6 (three-family) and all commercial zones.
rationale: The ordinance explicitly limits lot-coverage applicability to R-MF, R-6 three-family, and commercial zones (§6-5(34.1)). RA-4 is not included. Minimum Green Area (84% for RA-4, §6-205) remains auxiliary evidence and is not converted into maximum lot coverage, since §6-5(34.1)'s definition of Lot Coverage includes buildings, parking, driveways, decks, pools, patios, and terraces -- green area is not shown to be its legal complement.

source_excerpt: On lots used for single-family residence purposes, Short-term Residential Rentals, or for boarding or rooming houses sufficient garage space or outdoor parking space shall be provided to accommodate the passenger cars used by the residents of such premises.
rationale: §6-154 (Parking and Garages for Residential Purposes) is the controlling single-family residential parking provision for RA-4. It imposes a qualitative sufficiency requirement rather than a numeric minimum expressed as spaces per dwelling unit. Numeric parking schedules found elsewhere (§6-155: 1-1.6 spaces/bedroom for two-family/multi-family; §6-121: BMR units) apply to different uses and are not substituted for the RA-4 principal single-family rule.

source_excerpt: The following principal uses are permitted in RA-4, RA-2, RA-1, R-20 and R-12 Zones and all other principal uses are expressly excluded: (1) Detached single family dwellings, one (1) per lot.
rationale: Greenwich defines a multi-family dwelling (§6-5(19)) as a building containing three or more dwelling units. Multifamily housing is not among the enumerated RA-4 principal uses, and §6-93 expressly excludes all other principal uses. Therefore multifamily housing with three or more dwelling units is prohibited as a principal use in RA-4.
